explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/723: the conjecture is proved for n ≤ 11 (orders 6 and 10 are excluded by Bruck–Ryser and by Lam's computer search). Uses Mathlib's Configuration.ProjectivePlane (non-degenerate, finite here) and its order, which matches the page's notion of a finite projective plane of order n. The statement says every finite projective plane of order ≤ 11 has prime-power order. Faithful.
